episodes.title: Is Chabad a CULT?!
episodes.description:
LIVE DEBATE | FULL VIDEO
Four people with different experiences and perspectives on Chabad come together to discuss the definition of a cult, the structure and culture of the Chabad community, the positives of Chabad, and some of the criticisms and experiences of people who grew up within it.
Featuring: Rabbi Simon Jacobson, HannahfromtheTribe, Yoni Z, and Amor.Mendy
